headline: Remove objects from images
summary: Draw around anything in an image and RefBoard paints it out. Plus new ways to align rows and labels.

new.title: Remove object
new.description: Draw around anything in an image, and RefBoard paints it out from what is around it.
new.note: The first use downloads a 208 MB model once and needs a graphics card with WebGPU.
new.details: Remove as many things as you like, then press Enter to apply or Esc to cancel.

new.title: Align rows left, center or right
new.description: Select rows of items and line up their starts, middles or ends on one vertical line.

new.title: Label alignment
new.description: Labels under items can sit on the left, in the center or on the right.

improved.title: Security update
improved.description: Now runs on Electron 44.9.3, which no longer trusts a compromised certificate authority.

fixed.title: RefBoard reopens after an update
fixed.description: After Restart to update, the update installs and RefBoard comes back on its own.
